title: OpenAI o4-mini
before: Reasoning models were expensive enough to reserve for hard problems.
problem: Agents make many calls, so per-call reasoning cost compounds badly.
breakthrough: A small reasoning model cheap enough to call repeatedly, with tool use.
why: Cheap reasoning is what makes long agent loops economically possible.
next: The same logic drives the mini and flash tiers across all labs.
inherits: Reasoning at a price point agents can afford.
